# Ranging pairs research — completed, unsealed

Choosing pairs that ranged in the past did not meet the study’s fixed success rule with builder fees off. Across the primary current-Pacifica universe, their average simulated return difference was -0.730 percentage points versus trending pairs and -0.337 points versus all eligible pairs; these surviving-market, full-fill simulations do not establish future profitability.

**ADMITTED unique new path simulations: 1289774.** Attempted 1352832; rejected 63058; conservative derived outcomes 644887 add no simulations. Ineligible pair/calendar horizons 2738 are not attempted simulations.

## Coverage and certification

Candidates 126 (A 77 / B 49); funding survivors before candle certification 45 (A 25 / B 20), including 12 inherited markets and 33 additional histories. Final certification: 45 markets, A 25 / B 20; exclusions 81. Exact per-pair reasons and individual Gate fallback checks are in PAIR-COVERAGE.csv. No missing funding or candle is replaced with zero. Snapshot and raw HTTP hashes are frozen in C:/Apps/Replit/conductor-worktrees/grid-ranging-pairs-20261021-handback/evidence/coverage-20261021T100004840Z/frozen-snapshot-r2.json.

The original public-info capture contained 78 records: 77 perpetuals plus one other instrument. Exact mapping yielded 114 preferred OKX candidates, four preferred Gate candidates and eight unmatched candidates. The initial liquidity/first-month funding screen passed 63; full-period funding passed 45. All 33 previously pending candle histories now passed, alongside the 12 inherited histories. Of the 45 certified histories, 43 ever satisfy the preregistered score-window eligibility (23 in A); WLFI and XPL have no eligible selection or simulated launch. HYPE and ZEC are absent from the fixed-major comparator throughout, leaving BTC/ETH/SOL where eligible. The live fee response calls the requested base schedule level 0, although the brief calls it Tier 1; the numeric maker/taker rates are unchanged. Individual fallback audit dispositions accompany the original first-failure reasons in PAIR-COVERAGE.csv; the Gate endpoint rejected required old-history requests, without establishing that every possible Gate data service is unavailable.

Both universes are current survivors and omit dead/delisted markets; current liquidity and instrument constraints also introduce survivorship bias. A uses current Pacifica ticks/lots, bounds and at least USD 10 minimum; B uses actual OKX contract ticks/base-unit lots and USD 10 floor. External trade prices proxy marks. Full fills at historical grid prices are optimistic, especially for thin pairs. Median hourly high-low/mid is volatility-contaminated and is not an executable spread. Full-period and latest-30-day median daily quote volumes and current bid/ask spread are retained separately.

The required execution/funding period begins March 2022 or the first complete UTC listing day and ends October 19, 2026 exclusive. March/June/September/December selections require twelve months of prelaunch daily scores. The last quarter and 2026 are partial. Missing BTC/ETH/SOL/HYPE/ZEC comparator members remain missing; no replacements are made.

## Fixed design and interpretation

Binding preregistration commit hash: f7fc916fcebd2c17ac42c348c467d909ec98f2ae. Twelve-month Kaufman efficiency alone ranks floor-terciles with ASCII ties; six/twelve-month containment and mean crossings are descriptive and saved in selections.json. Hindsight is chosen on full-period efficiency, intersected with point-in-time eligibility: it is unattainable at launch and not a mathematical upper bound on grid profit.

One weekly launch rotates the sizing-study 21 weekday/hour slots. Ten intervals, week/month range, shipped touch stops, step_back, seed on, USD 1,000, Equal/Equal, Further/Near and Further/Further, 1x/3x, 14/30 days, independent long/short. Product sizing and the inherited round-2 funding/liquidation/mark-stop engine are reused. Maker/taker base fees are 0.015%/0.040%; builder 0% primary and 0.10% secondary; terminal taker exit plus 0.05% adverse slippage. The lower-return OHLC/OLHC path supplies every metric; liquidation, stop and seed-hold outcomes stay admitted.

Return aggregation averages configurations/directions within pair, pairs within cohort, then weeks equally. Differences require mutual calendar/configuration admission; sizing differences first require mutual arm admission within pair. Calendar-week percentile bootstrap uses 10,000 draws, seed 20261021, with one-week primary and four-week circular sensitivity and empty intervening calendar weeks retained. CIs are unadjusted exploratory intervals except the fixed primary decision. Earlier years were examined in prior research, so this is locked reuse rather than a fresh holdout.

Actual evaluable comparison cells: 3060; individual metric/block bootstrap intervals: 93240. All fee/leverage/sizing/range/year crossings, admissions and tail metrics are below and in RANGING-PAIRS-ALL-CELLS.csv. Return/drawdown/rate values below are percent or percentage points; underwater time is days. Worst 5% is the fractional-weight lower-tail statistic under equal week/pair weights, not an independent sample. Liquidation/stop counts count conservative outcomes within each displayed cell and overlap across cells.

## Primary decision

Success: NO. Ranging minus trending: -0.730 [-1.102, -0.359] pp; ranging minus all: -0.337 [-0.552, -0.126] pp. Positive quarterly ranging-minus-trending windows: 4/15. Matched worst-5% returns: ranging -28.755, trending -25.677, ranging matched to all -28.758, all -27.143. Matched worst drawdowns: ranging 71.766, trending 63.912, ranging matched to all 71.766, all 74.285.
